title.zh: 合作社（第 71(2)(b) 条规定缴款率）规则 2026
title.en: Co-operative Societies (Prescribed Rate of Contribution under Section 71(2)(b)) Rules 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Co-operative Societies (Prescribed Rate of Contribution under Section 71(2)(b)) Rules 2026.

heading.en: Prescribed rate of contribution under section 71(2)(b) of Act

text.en: 2. The rate of 15% is prescribed in substitution of 20% for the contribution payable under section 71(2)(b) of the Act by a society in respect of any surplus resulting from its operations during any financial year ending on or after 31 December 2025.
